'''Odux''' were domesticated quadrupedal horned [[Species/Legends|beasts]] of burden that were ridden by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings<ref name="Reveal" /> around [[3623 BBY]].<ref name="LotS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref> There were a number of Odux variants, including "Mudland," "Firebrand," "Resplendent," and "Snowblind" Odux.<ref name="Reveal" />

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Odux were announced to appear in the [[2022]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|''Legacy of the Sith'']] to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', specifically in "Galactic Season 4: 'A Passage of Peace'" which debuted with the launch of Game Update 7.2.1 on [[March 28]], [[2023]].<ref name="Reveal" />
